original: tatrāgnīṣomapadasyohaḥ kāryaṃ iti viśeṣaḥ | āhūtāyāṃ pitāputrīyāyāṃ dṛḍhaṃ kumbhamādāyāntareṇa cātvālātkarāvudaṅ upaniṣkramya srotobhimukhaṃ sthitvā chāyātapasoḥ sandhau vasatīvarīsaṃjñā apo gṛhṇāti | haviṣmatīrimā āpo haviṣmān devo adhvaro haviṣmāṃ āvivāsati haviṣmāṃ astu sūryaḥ | iti | sūrye tvastaṅgate hiraṇyamantardhāya gṛhṇāti |
analyzed: tatra agnīṣoma padasya ūhaḥ kāryam iti viśeṣaḥ āhūtāyām pitāputrīyāyām dṛḍham kumbham ādāya antareṇa cātvālāt karau udaṅ upaniṣkramya srotaḥ abhimukham sthitvā chāyā tapasoḥ sandhau vasatīvarī saṃjñāḥ apaḥ gṛhṇāti haviṣmatīḥ imāḥ āpaḥ haviṣmān devaḥ adhvaraḥ haviṣmān āvivāsati haviṣmān astu sūryaḥ iti sūrye hiraṇyam antardhāya gṛhṇāti

original: ātapacchāyāyāṃ svadehacchāyāyāṃ vṛkṣacchāyāyāṃ vā gṛhṇāti | idaṃ vasatīvarīgrahaṇamityucyate ||
analyzed: ātapa chāyāyām sva deha chāyāyām vṛkṣa chāyāyām vā gṛhṇāti idam vasatīvarī grahaṇam iti ucyate

original: tataḥ pradakṣiṇamāvṛtya vasatīvarīkumbhaṃ savye nidhāyāntareṇa cātvālotkarāvuttareṇāgnīdhrīyaṃ sadaśca gatvā pūrvayādvārā śālāṃ prapādya śālāmukhīyasya paścātsaṃsṛṣṭāḥ sādayati | agnervopannagṛhasya sadasi sādayāmi sumnāya sumninīḥ sumne mā dhatta | iti etadvasatīvarīsādanamucyate |
analyzed: tatas pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya vasatīvarī kumbham savye nidhāya antareṇa cātvāla utkarau uttareṇa āgnīdhrīyam sadaḥ ca gatvā pūrvayā dvārā śālām prapādya śālāmukhīyasya paścāt saṃsṛṣṭāḥ sādayati agneḥ vā upanna gṛhasya sadasi sādayāmi sumnāya sumninīḥ sumne mā dhatta iti etat vasatīvarī sādanam ucyate

original: tato 'gnīnpuroḍāśamityādi svaruhomavarjamājyeḍāntaṃ paśuvat | aupayājā'ṅgāraharaṇamāgnīdhrīyāditi viśeṣaḥ | vṛtrahābhūyāsamiti puroḍāśayāge yajamānasyānumantraṇam | indriyāvī bhūyāsamityaṅgayāge| ājyeḍāmārjanānte ulūkhale musala ityeva hutvā dhruvāmāpyāyya prāyaścittāni juhoti na vā|
analyzed: tatas gnīn puroḍāśam ityādi svaru homa varjam ājya iḍā antam paśu vat aupayāja aṅgāra haraṇam āgnīdhrīyāt iti viśeṣaḥ vṛtra hā bhūyāsam iti puroḍāśa yāge yajamānasya anumantraṇam indriyāvī bhūyāsam iti aṅga yāge ājya iḍā mārjana ante ulūkhale musale iti eva hutvā dhruvām āpyāyya prāyaścittāni juhoti na vā

original: athāgnīṣomīya ityata ārabhya etadantaṃ karma agnīṣomīyapaśuriti gīyate|
analyzed: atha agnīṣomīyaḥ iti atas ārabhya etad antam karma agnīṣomīya paśuḥ iti gīyate

original: hṛdayaśūlaṃ prakṣālya sthāpayitvā sampreṣyati| vyapakrāmataṃ mā vo'bhipariṣam | iti | ayaṃ bahirvedibhavanapraiṣa ucyate |
analyzed: hṛdayaśūlam prakṣālya sthāpayitvā sampreṣyati vyapakrāmatam mā iti ayam bahirvedi bhavana praiṣaḥ ucyate

original: tataḥ sarvai bahirvedi bhavanti | vasatīvarīrādāya gārhapatyasya paścānmārgeṇa nītvā dakṣiṇayā dvāropaniṣkra
analyzed: tatas sarvaiḥ bahirvedi bhavanti vasatīvarīḥ ādāya gārhapatyasya paścāt mārgeṇa nītvā dakṣiṇayā dvāra upaniṣkram

original: mya savyeṃse nidhāya dakṣiṇena mārjālīyaṃ sadaśca paryāhṛtyodaṅmukho dakṣiṇato yūpena saṃsṛṣṭāḥ sādayati indrāgniyorbhāgatheyī stha | iti punarādāyodaṅṅāvṛtya dakṣiṇeṃse nidhāya yathetametya śālāmukhīyasya paścātsaṃsṛṣṭā sādayati mitrāvaruṇayorbhāgadheyī stha iti |
analyzed: savya iṃse nidhāya dakṣiṇena mārjālīyam sadaḥ ca paryāhṛtya udak mukhaḥ dakṣiṇatas yūpena saṃsṛṣṭāḥ sādayati indra agnyoḥ bhāgatheyīḥ sthaḥ iti punar ādāya udaṅ āvṛtya dakṣiṇa iṃse nidhāya yathetam etya śālāmukhīyasya paścāt saṃsṛṣṭā sādayati mitrāvaruṇayoḥ bhāgadheyīḥ sthaḥ iti

original: punarādāya dakṣiṇeṃse nidhāya pūrvayā dvāropaniṣkramya uttareṇa sada āgnīyaṃ ca parītyottarato yūpena saṃsṛṣṭāḥ sādayati | viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ bhāgadheyī stha| iti punarādāya pradakṣiṇamāvṛtya savyeṃse nidhāya punastenaiva mārgeṇāgatyāgnīdhrīyasya niṣṇayasya paścātsaṃsṛṣṭāḥ sādayati | yajñe jāgṛta | iti | idaṃ vasatīvarīsthāpanamucyate|
analyzed: punar ādāya dakṣiṇa iṃse nidhāya pūrvayā dvārā upaniṣkramya uttareṇa sadaḥ āgnīyam ca parītya uttaratas yūpena saṃsṛṣṭāḥ sādayati viśveṣām devānām bhāgadheyīḥ stha iti punar ādāya pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya savya iṃse nidhāya punar tena eva mārgeṇa āgatya āgnīdhrīyasya niṣṇayasya paścāt saṃsṛṣṭāḥ sādayati yajñe jāgṛta iti idam vasatīvarī sthāpanam ucyate
